scripts.build: npm run build -w @oa/contracts && npm run build -w @oa/api && npm run build -w @oa/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @oa/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @oa/api" "npm run dev -w @oa/web"
scripts.package:production: node scripts/assert-node-version.mjs && npm run build:bundle -w @oa/api && npm run build -w @oa/web && node scripts/build-production-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build -w @oa/contracts && npm run test -w @oa/contracts && npm run test -w @oa/api && npm run test -w @oa/web
scripts.verify:production: npm run package:production && npm run smoke:production
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @oa/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @oa/api && npm run typecheck -w @oa/web
